welcome.title: Welcome to myNextDays
welcome.text: Your business will be ready in just a few steps. We'll create your first property, set a price and connect your booking channels.

company.title: Company details
company.text: These details belong to your account and are used, among other things, for invoices and connecting your booking portals.
company.billingEmailHint: Pre-filled with your login email — editable for invoices/contact.

branch.title: Are you already active on booking portals?
branch.text: If you already rent out on Booking.com or Airbnb, for example, we'll connect your existing accounts and import your properties & bookings — no need to set anything up twice.
branch.noDesc: Create a new property and connect channels from scratch
branch.whichPortals: Which portals do you already use?

object.title: Your first property
object.text: Create your first rentable property. You can add details (address, photos, amenities) later.
object.name: Property name
object.namePlaceholder: e.g. Double room with lake view

price.title: Base price per night
price.text: Set a starting price. You can fine-tune seasonal and channel prices later.

channels.notReady: Channel connectivity is currently being set up for your business. You can complete it any time later under "Channel Manager".
channels.importIntro: We'll connect your existing accounts and import properties & bookings. Choose the portals you want to connect:
channels.importHint: The connection assistant (access + property mapping) opens embedded. You can also open it later under "Channel Manager".
channels.newIntro: Your property is created. As soon as you connect channels, we'll automatically distribute availability and prices to Booking.com, Airbnb & co. — and bookings land directly in your calendar.

done.title: Done — your business is ready to go!
done.text: You can now create more properties, refine prices and finalize your channel connections in the dashboard.
